howto: Pick Adventure (24 levels with stars), Classic (play as long as you can) or Daily blocks.
Drag one of the three blocks from the tray onto the board. It floats above your finger so you can see where it lands.
Fill a whole row or column to blast it away; clear lines on back-to-back moves for a combo.
The game ends when none of your blocks fits. In Adventure, reach the goal before your blocks run out.
tips: Blocks never rotate, so keep room for long bars and the big L.
The board glows the lines a block would finish before you let go.
Every clear charges the bomb meter; at 5 a bomb joins your tray and wipes a 3x3 area.
Gems hide inside blocks in Adventure: clear the row or column that holds one.
Undo (3 per game) and Swap (2 per game) can rescue a crowded board; Hint shows a good spot.

controls.keyboard: 1, 2 or 3 picks a block, arrow keys move it, Enter drops it, Z undoes, H hints. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag a block from the tray onto the board and lift your finger to drop it. Undo, Swap, Hint and Menu sit under the tray.

difficulty: Adventure levels get tighter from world to world (fewer blocks, more filled squares). Classic and Daily use an adaptive curve: small blocks first, small again when the board is crowded, and every tray can be finished.

cheats.effect: Bomb squad: a bomb joins your tray right now
Tiny blocks: every new block is 3 squares or fewer
Fresh tray: swap your blocks for three new ones
More undo: ten undos and ten swaps

features.hints: Hint button (and Pause > Hint): tries every block in every spot, picks the drop that clears most (or grabs a gem) and shows it as a breathing outline on the board
features.undo: Undo button (or Z) takes back the last drop, restoring the same blocks; 3 per game
features.level-select-or-daily: Adventure: 3 worlds x 8 levels with a 3-star rating each; Daily blocks: everyone gets the same blocks in the same order today, with its own daily best
features.results: A result card with score, best, lines, best combo, bombs and XP earned; Adventure shows the stars
features.tutorial: First game: a guided board where you drag a two-square block into a gap and blast your first row; skippable, replayed from How to play
features.progression: Adventure 24 levels x 3 stars (worlds unlock at 10 and 28 stars); XP levels unlock 6 board looks; 3 daily goals, a weekly stamp card with a chest; 8 trophies
